name: Densidad Semántica
description: Mide information density uniformity a través de content.
useCase: Detección de texto IA mediante densidad de información uniforme
mechanism: Segments content into columns and mide entropía in each. AI text distributes information too evenly, while escritura humana has natural density variations.
source: Dugan et al. (2023) - Real or Fake Text? Investigating Human Ability to Detect Boundaries
parameters: Tamaño de ventana: adaptativo, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropía, CV, correlación
strengths:
- Effective for detecting generado por IA text
- Language-agnostic estadístico approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger falsos positivos
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies a través de estilo de escrituras

references.title: Dugan et al. (2023) - Real or Fake Text? Investigating Human Ability to Detect Boundaries
Mitchell, E. et al. (2023). DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature. ICML.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. arXiv.
